title: Optimal dictator experiment guarantee
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with a nonempty alphabet, let $T$ be a finite randomised tester, and let $r$ be a natural number such that every test selected by a seed has arity at most $r$. Suppose that for every alphabet coordinate, the tester's acceptance probability on the corresponding dictator function is at least $ eta$, and that the optimum value of the unique-game constraint instance associated with $G$ is at least $1-\delta$. Then the experiment value of the dictator code induced by an optimal labeling of $G$ is at least $\beta-r\delta$.
